verdict.rationale: Otter has a public pricing page that lists per-tier features and limits, such as 3 lifetime file imports, 3 concurrent meetings, API & Webhooks and enhanced admin features. Community posts confirm a free tier and describe Otter as affordable for individuals. However, no tier prices appear in the evidence, and it is unclear which features sit in which tier. The only 'contact your account manager' gate shown is for an enterprise data-training option, not basic use. Missing for 10: actual per-tier prices, a clear tier-by-tier mapping of what each plan adds, and confirmation that self-serve signup reaches paid tiers without sales.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start free and see exactly what each paid tier costs and adds — no "talk to sales" wall for basic use

citations.quote: Enhanced admin features: activity logs, usage analytics, and more
Otter was not reviewing tickets from free users at the time
Otter is the only thing approaching affordable for individuals
